::: {#def-rnffrcitg .theorem}
## RNFFRCISTG

A random network finest fully randomized causally interpretable structured tree graph (RNFFRCISTG) model is a causal model defined on a [random graph NPSEM-NE](#def-npsem-ne) which satisfies the (1) [no spillover](#def-no-spillover), (2) [homogenous random network interference](#def-homogenous-random-network-interference) with respect to random graph set $\mathcal H $, and (3) [identical distributions](#def-identical-distributions) assumptions.
:::
